claims.excerpt: # Fourth Global Coral Bleaching Event Set a Record for Heat-Stress Exposure
claims.claim: The fourth global coral bleaching event set a record for heat-stress exposure.
claims.label: F2 material incorrect, unsupported or misleading
claims.evidence: From January 1, 2023 through September 30, 2025, roughly 84.4% of global coral reef area experienced bleaching-level heat stress. The previous global event ran from 2014 to 2017 and exposed 68.2% of reef area to bleaching-level heat stress.
claims.narrative: The scale of the heat-stress footprint—larger than the 68.2% recorded during the 2014–2017 event—makes the event record-setting by measured exposure
claims.explanation: The source supports that the measured footprint exceeded the previous event’s, but does not establish that it was a record across all earlier events.
claims.materiality: High: the record claim is the headline’s central assertion.
